text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
As expected of a Classic race...—
It's not 
gonna go down easily, huh...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(Still...! That's exactly what gets me 
fired up...!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Man,
the Big Four were amazing yet again! 
Personally, I'm definitely keeping my 
hopes high for Bubble Gum Fellow."

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what will happen at the Nippon 
Derby? I can't wait to see!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —...We did it, Bubble.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
To be able to run safely... I'm truly so 
glad.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...That was a good run.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Just like you, I will—

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: …………Yeah――

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
That was truly incredible... Everyone... 
truly...—

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
"So next time,
I will definitely... I will 
definitely make it there too...!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —I'm home, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bubble Gum Fellow returned after running 
the Satsuki Sho. There was a strangely 
refreshing spark dwelling in his eyes.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...I knew it,
the Classic races really are 
incredible.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is so genuinely strong and 
passionate.
I can still feel the lingering 
heat through my body—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
And... that's precisely why I'm getting 
fired up too...! Wanting to become even 
stronger...!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Once again... thank you so much for 
bringing me here.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Fufu— I'll be counting on you for the 
Japan Derby too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And so, the Satsuki Sho that Bubble 
Gum Fellow and I finally reached came
to a 
safe close—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The next day.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"...While there is fatigue from the 
Satsuki Sho, there doesn't appear to be 
any damage that could lead to an injury."

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"As long as you stay as mindful as you've 
been so far, you should be able to run in 
the Japanese Derby without issue."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Thank goodness—

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
...That said, the Nippon Derby is longer 
than the Satsuki Sho,
and there's no doubt 
it will be an even tougher race.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, the fiercer a race becomes,
the 
more you must push your legs to win, 
making you far more susceptible to taking 
damage.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Even if things went well this time, 
injuries in future races are still 
entirely possible.
Please always keep that 
in mind.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
――Alright! Once we get back to the 
academy, we've gotta get plenty of rest 
first.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: All right, I'm taking a break today...!
choice_data_list: Yeah, right now it's important to ...
Yeah, right now it's important to ...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...I can't wait. The Nippon Derby, that 
is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Toward the grand stage to determine the 
pinnacle of their generation, the Nippon 
Derby, they pressed forward with renewed 
resolve—"
